question: The Dudhsagar waterfall is a major tourist place of _______ State.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Goa**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Dudhsagar Waterfall is located on the Mandovi River in the Indian state of Goa.
 
• It is one of the tallest waterfalls in India, with a height of 310 meters (1017 feet).
 
• Dudhsagar translates to 'Sea of Milk' in Konkani, referencing the white frothy water cascading down the rocks.
 
• The waterfall is a popular tourist attraction, especially during the monsoon season when it is in full flow.
 
• It is situated in the Bhagwan Mahaveer Sanctuary and Mollem National Park, adding to its natural beauty and biodiversity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tourism in Goa:** Goa is known for its stunning beaches, vibrant nightlife, and rich cultural heritage.
 
• **Bhagwan Mahaveer Sanctuary:** This sanctuary is the largest wildlife reserve in Goa, covering an area of 240 square kilometers.
 
• **Western Ghats:** Dudhsagar Waterfall is part of the Western Ghats, a UNESCO World Heritage site and one of the eight "hottest hotspots" of biological diversity in the world.
 
• **Accessibility:** The waterfall is accessible by a short hike or by a jeep safari through the lush forest, adding an element of adventure for visitors.
 
• **Railway View:** The waterfall can also be viewed from a train journey on the Vasco Da Gama – Londa route, providing a picturesque experience for travelers.
